visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of people is gathered in a modern, brightly lit living room around a low coffee table filled with bowls and dishes. An elderly woman with short dark hair, wearing a black and white patterned tunic, is seated on a small, soft cream-colored ottoman. Behind her, a younger woman in a grey hoodie holds a baby in a yellow top. Several young men and women are sitting on the floor or a nearby sofa, holding chopsticks and eating. Red countdown numbers 3, 2, 1 appear over the scene. (2) The elderly woman suddenly tips backward as her ottoman slides, her arms flailing and eyes widening in surprise. Yellow cartoonish impact sparks are edited over her head. The scene cuts to a flashback/security recording showing a man in a white shirt standing on a chair and falling over in a closet area, with a date stamp 2024/12/13. (3) Back in the present, a man in a tan tank top sneakily slides a massive white beanbag chair directly behind the elderly woman as she eats. She eventually leans back and falls again, but this time she lands softly in the beanbag. The surrounding group points and laughs hysterically. The girl with pink hair and others are seen eating and reacting with amusement while the grandma smiles from her safe landing spot.
